title: A deeply nested multipart MIME structure constructed via the public API causes a stack overflow in libcurl during normal cleanup operations. (CVE-2026-92391)
description: A stack overflow vulnerability exists in libcurl triggered by a deeply nested multipart MIME structure created via the public API. The issue occurs during normal cleanup operations when the function curl_mime_free encounters excessive recursion depth, causing unbounded stack frame allocation and crashing the host process.
aiSummary: CVE-2026-92391 describes a stack overflow in libcurl caused by constructing a deeply nested multipart MIME structure through the public API. During cleanup, the curl_mime_free function recursively traverses the MIME structure. Excessive nesting leads to unbounded recursion depth, resulting in stack frame exhaustion and a crash of the host process.
aiImpact: The vulnerability causes a denial of service by crashing the host process due to stack overflow during cleanup of multipart MIME data. There is no information about code execution or data corruption impacts.
